RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel creates risks of unconscious or affinity bias, but on its own, it does not prove sex discrimination. For head of risk modelling roles, "broad regulatory experience" is often a legitimate, heavily weighted business criterion alongside technical quantitative credentials. The two-week delay in written feedback is poor HR practice, but relatively common.

Do not immediately accuse the bank of bias, as this risks burning professional bridges without concrete evidence. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback, specifically asking how your background compared regarding regulatory leadership. If their response reveals shifting criteria, inconsistent explanations, or persistent silence, consult an employment lawyer to assess whether to raise a formal grievance.
